text_block_list.text:
The event T.M. Opera O invited Meisho
Doto to is the Tracen Meet, a competition
held multiple times a year to both
challenge and
celebrate the students.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And for our showing to be a success, we
must rehearse! We shall meet on the turf
course tomorrow at one o'clock sharp!
Ta-ta for now, Doto!
Hah ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. Wh-what a shock...
I-I think I lost
consciousness for a second
there...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hm? Yes, of co—huh?! D-did O-Ope...Opera O really just... ask me for something?! A-and a battle at that?! Whaaat?!

She's a lot more flustered than I would've
expected. Not to mention the way she was
looking at T.M. Opera O with so much...
admiration.
Could it be...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
N-no,
I don't deserve to call myself a fan...
It's more like... I-I look up
to her, I
suppose...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
M-maybe that's a bit confusing... Um...

W-when I first saw Opera O at our
entrance ceremony...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hah ha ha! Look at these decorated walls,
the gilded stage, an auditorium at full
capacity! Good to see the school celebrate
my
enrollment appropriately!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
To say she stood out would be an
understatement. Her laugh echoed

through the halls as she entered, and
then...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Listen well, my comrades and rivals!
Today, my journey along the road
to
victory—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: She tripped in the middle of her speech.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A-are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Can you imagine? Tripping over your own two feet... in front of the whole school... on the first day?! I would've had nightmares for months! But not her...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Haaah ha ha ha ha! Excellent! Could
there be more crushing humiliation than
this?! What luck to come across such
emotion so
serendipitously!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(Sh-she's not embarassed? In fact...
sh-she
seems even more majestic
than before...
A-amazing... H-how?)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: (I-I want to be like that too!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O asking me for help... was likely—no, probably—no, surely—no, definitely pure coincidence...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-but even so... if she thinks I can
somehow be of help to her, I-I want
to do
my very best!

The next day, curiosity gets the better of
me, and I decide to watch Meisho Doto
and T.M. Opera O. However, something's
amiss when I
get there...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hah ha ha! To think she would be thirty
minutes late on our very first
day!

Recalling her overall clumsiness,
I start to
worry that she may have
fallen and injured
herself somewhere. But just then...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-I'M SO SORRY!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
F-forgive me! Prepping took me a little
longer than I thought! I-I'll
enter the gate
right away! I'm so, so, soooo sorry!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hold it right there, Doto. Do you truly
believe we can race with you in
such a
state?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eep! I-I-I mean... that is... I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You're still wearing your slippers.

And so, Meisho Doto rushes back to the
dorms to retrieve her running
shoes. Just a
little longer, and this race can begin...
...Or so I thought. Night has fallen.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hah ha ha ha! What incredible tardiness!

Too tardy if you ask me...
Surely something
happened this time—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'm so, so, so, so, so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Really,
truly! I can't even begin to explain!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
W-well...
I-I was so excited yesterday that
I decided to polish my shoes... But when I
was done, I put them in a different place
than usual. So when I went looking...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Are they here? What about here? What
about over here?! Surely
they're right here!
Why aren't they here?! WHERE ARE
THEY?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eventually I did manage to find them,
but...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Th-the cleats fell off! Whyyy?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I must've reapplied them too many
times last night... The holes
from the nails
are too big! B-but that means... Ohhh, I'm
such an idiot!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
S-so I had to go buy new shoes, which
took even longer... S-sorry
doesn't even
begin to cover—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, y-you're right! I should've just—Wait,
no, it's a little late for that
now! What's
done is done, and I-I need to make up for
being so tardy!

It's already nighttime, and surely Opera O
is sick of waiting. But when
I look over at
her, she only smiles.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh, a few accidents will not sway the
heart of the Overlord! Besides, look
yonder at the moon! O how she shines! She
urges us to run, so
run we shall!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you, Opera O...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(Th-then for your sake, I have to at least
be a good running partner! I
have to be
useful!)

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh... You're showing true grit there,
Doto! But I will not falter!
Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-yaaah!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hngyah?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...Ha! Well, villain? Did you enjoy that
small sample of my—oh? Did
you trip?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry!
Not only did I make you wait
for me until it was pitch
black outside, but
I couldn't even give you a proper race!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
H-how can I even begin to make this up to
you... Ah, I-I know, I
brought th-these
refreshments with me...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Although preparing this was another
reason I was late... I'm sorry...

Meisho Doto hands over a hot cup of
coffee and all is well... for
about half a
second.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
This... isn't coffee,
is it? Tastes more like
soy sauce to me!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
S-s-soy sauce?! Oh no, now I've done it!
Um... Uh... I-I also brought this towel,
which I sprayed with a lovely fragrance!
Please take it
and—

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Cough, cough! T-the stench... It burns...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
EEEK! A-are you okay?! ARE YOU OKAY?!
OPERA O!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hic... Sniff... I-I can't believe I caused the Opera O to faint...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: S-still... I thought I'd finally be useful for once, but in the end... all I did was cause trouble... Sniff...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I really am the most worthless
Umamusume everrr!

Doto races off, distraught by her own
failures. It's clear she put a lot
of effort
into today, so I understand why she's
upset... Concerned, I race after her.
